title: History - HAWE Hydraulik- Hawe Hydraulik SE
content: # History of HAWE. Karl Heilmeier, an engineer with a keen sense for technical innovation, and Wilhelm Weinlein, an experienced businessman with a feel for market opportunities, founded the company "Heilmeier & Weinlein" in Munich in 1949. Derived from the pronunciation of the two initials of the company's founders, H and W, this was already established in 1950 as an abbreviation for the brand name of the products. As a sign of further development, when HAWE became a international global player, the company was transformed into a Societas Europaea, HAWE Hydraulik SE, in 2008. In 1949, Karl Heilmeier and Wilhelm Weinlein founded the company "Heilmeier & Weinlein" in Munich, which was renamed HAWE Hydraulik SE in 2008. In 1952, HAWE Hydraulik took part in the Hannover Messe for the first time, where HAWE's first innovative hydraulic solutions were presented to a wide audience at one of the most important industrial trade fairs in the world.
